items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: he and Bonnie B. Garth would run over, things like that.

ctx.x: Well, one particular time I remember Jelly Man. Lou and I were playing with Carol Dickinson's band at the Savoy, you know, in Chicago. So we had rehearsal that day. So after rehearsal, we were walking down South Parkway and who we ran into but Jelly. Boy, the old Jelly was so sharp that they had on a pale pink silk shirt and a Panama hat looked like it cost about 25 hours in those days, you know. It was real good, you know.
